stats.done_summary: Successfully implemented and applied the Temporal Stability Index (TSI) to the model_output column of experiment_traces.csv. The TSI formula was implemented as specified: TSI = max(0, min(1, 1 - σ_d/(σ_x + ε))) where σ_x and σ_d are population standard deviations (ddof=0) of the series and its first differences, respectively. For the full series of 5,000 samples, the computed TSI is **0.968440**, indicating high temporal stability. The analysis includes: (1) custom TSI implementation in code/tsi_analysis.py, (2) intermediate results saved to outputs/tsi_results.txt, (3) comprehensive report in report/report.md with 5 visualization figures showing time series, distributions, rolling TSI analysis, segment analysis, and component breakdown.
